encounter.chief_complaint: Exertional shortness of breath and intermittent chest pain for two weeks

notes.title: Hypertension review
notes.text: PRIOR-NOTE-ALPHA: blood pressure controlled on amlodipine 5 mg; advised salt restriction and follow-up in three months.

notes.title: Lipid panel follow-up
notes.text: PRIOR-NOTE-BRAVO: LDL 3.9 mmol/L; started atorvastatin 20 mg nocte; no myalgia reported.

data.case_note: History of present illness includes shortness of breath on exertion and intermittent chest pain over the past two weeks. Physical examination revealed a heart rate of 88 and regular, with lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally. The differential diagnosis includes stable angina. Plan included starting Aspirin 81 milligrams daily for stable angina. An electrocardiogram and a troponin level were ordered.
